en.name: Popcorn kernels
en.summary: A sealed jar of popcorn kernels keeps 2 years from purchase, and 1 year once opened. Unlike almost every other dry good, the thing you are protecting is not freshness but moisture — a kernel pops because of the water sealed inside it, and a dried-out kernel simply will not.
en.pantry: 2 years from purchase sealed, 1 year after opening, in a cool, dry, dark cupboard and in a genuinely airtight jar. Popcorn kernels are hard, dry seeds with nothing on the outside to go rancid, so they do not spoil the way nuts do. What they do is slowly lose the small amount of moisture locked inside each kernel, and that moisture is what flashes to steam and blows the kernel inside out. Old, dry kernels give you a pan of half-popped stubs rather than anything dangerous.
en.fridge: No refrigerated timeline is published, and it is not a good idea. The old advice to keep kernels in the fridge or freezer to improve popping does the opposite over time: cold, dry air pulls moisture out of the kernel, and moisture is the thing making it pop. An airtight jar at room temperature holds that internal water far better.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published either, and for the same reason it is not recommended. The freezer is the driest place in the kitchen, and a season in there leaves kernels that pop poorly. If kernels have already dried out, a common fix is to add a teaspoon of water to a jarful, shake it, and leave it sealed for a couple of days before trying again.
en.thawing: Not applicable — popcorn kernels are not a frozen food and are best kept sealed at room temperature.
spoilage: A pan full of unpopped stubs, which means the kernels have dried out.
A musty or mouldy smell, from a jar that took up moisture.
Weevils, moths or webbing in the jar.
Kernels that look shrivelled, cracked or dusty rather than glossy.
tips: Store in a screw-top glass jar, not the bag; the bag lets moisture out slowly.
Keep the jar out of the fridge and the freezer — dry cold is what kills popping.
Revive dry kernels with a teaspoon of water per jar, shaken and left sealed for a day or two.
Label the jar with the purchase date; kernels look identical for years.

faq.q: How long do popcorn kernels keep?
faq.a: 2 years from purchase in a sealed jar, and 1 year once opened, stored airtight in a cool, dry cupboard.

faq.q: Should popcorn kernels be kept in the fridge or freezer?
faq.a: No. Cold, dry air draws moisture out of the kernel, and it is that trapped moisture that makes it pop. Keep them in an airtight jar at room temperature.
The kernels have dried out. Add about a teaspoon of water per jar, shake, seal and leave it a day or two, then try again.

zh.name: 爆米花玉米粒
zh.summary: 密封的爆米花玉米粒自購買日起可放 2 年，開封後 1 年。和幾乎所有乾貨不同，這裡要保護的不是新鮮度而是水分——玉米粒會爆，靠的是封在裡面的那點水；乾掉的玉米粒就是不會爆。
zh.pantry: 未開封自購買日起 2 年，開封後 1 年，放在陰涼、乾燥、避光的櫥櫃，並且用真正氣密的玻璃罐。玉米粒是又硬又乾的種子，外表沒有什麼可以油耗的東西，所以它不會像堅果那樣壞掉。它會做的，是慢慢失去每一粒裡鎖住的那一點水分，而那點水正是瞬間變成蒸汽、把玉米粒從裡面炸開的關鍵。放太久的玉米粒只會給你一鍋半開不開的殘渣，不會給你危險。
zh.fridge: 沒有冷藏的期限數據，而且這不是個好主意。「把玉米粒冰起來比較會爆」這個老說法，長期來看效果剛好相反：又冷又乾的空氣會把玉米粒裡的水抽出來，而水正是它爆開的本錢。常溫的氣密罐能把那些內部水分留得好得多。
zh.freezer: 冷凍同樣沒有期限數據，理由一樣，不建議。冷凍庫是全廚房最乾的地方，放上一季，玉米粒就爆不太起來了。如果已經乾掉，常見的補救是一罐加一小匙水、搖一搖，密封放個兩天再試。
zh.thawing: 不適用——爆米花玉米粒不是冷凍食品，最好密封放在常溫。
spoilage: 一鍋下來全是沒爆開的殘粒，代表玉米粒已經乾掉。
受潮的罐子出現霉味或發霉。
罐子裡有米蟲、穀蛾或絲網。
玉米粒乾癟、龜裂或灰撲撲的，而不是飽滿有光澤。
tips: 用旋蓋玻璃罐，不要留在原本的袋子裡；袋子會慢慢讓水分跑掉。
不要冷藏也不要冷凍——乾冷正是讓它爆不開的原因。
乾掉的玉米粒，一罐加約一小匙水搖勻、密封放一兩天再試。
在罐上寫購買日期；玉米粒放好幾年外觀都一樣。

faq.q: 爆米花玉米粒可以放多久？
faq.a: 密封放陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃，自購買日起 2 年；開封後 1 年。

faq.q: 玉米粒要冰冰箱或冷凍嗎？
faq.a: 不要。乾冷的空氣會把玉米粒裡的水抽走，而那些水正是它爆開的關鍵。常溫氣密罐就好。

faq.q: 為什麼我的玉米粒爆不開？
faq.a: 它乾掉了。一罐加約一小匙水，搖勻密封放一兩天再試一次。
